about: Recorded demo data for Module 7 (MGMT 615, fictional). Each module's 90-minute cohort session after the refresh: title, the decision it centers on, what students get live (feedback, own job, practice, instructor judgment, assessment preview), segments (check understanding, guided practice, the live part, then debrief), the RSI moments, and setup needs for the Instructional Technologist. 'review' holds refresh flags and resolutions. MGMT 615 meets on Thursdays; 'early' is the same module's session for a Monday or Tuesday meeting.

modules.title: Who Gets the Bonus?
modules.decision: Keep, adjust, or replace the pick-rate bonus
modules.live: Your judgment on a messy case
segments: 10 min: check understanding: a poll on which link in expectancy theory the bonus breaks, then a recap of Dana's situation
15 min: guided practice: diagnose Luis together, with students naming the motivation problem in the chat
25 min: each breakout gets one piece of evidence (bonus data, Luis's record, the crew's view)
25 min: groups combine evidence and recommend
15 min: instructor's call and why
review: 'Diagnosing Motivation Problems Roundtable' named no live moment and failed the recording test as written. Resolution: split-evidence breakouts added.

segments: 15 min: recap last week: a poll on what Dana should have done first, and what the instructor saw in the first-week plans
15 min: introduce the module: the pick-rate bonus, and Luis, who refuses to chase it
50 min: introductory activity: groups make a first call on keeping, adjusting, or replacing the bonus, and list the evidence they'd need
10 min: preview the week: the motivation reading, the evidence files, and the diagnosis due Sunday

modules.title: Rehearse the Conversation With Jordan
modules.decision: Coach, warn, or coach and document
segments: 10 min: check understanding: a poll on which part of SBI is missing from Greg's warning
15 min: guided practice: the instructor models the first two minutes with Jordan, and the class names each SBI part
40 min: breakouts of three, rotating Dana, Jordan, and observer
15 min: observers report the strongest line they heard
10 min: preview
15 min: recap last week: a poll on the bonus decision, and what the instructor saw in the diagnoses
15 min: introduce the module: Greg wants a formal warning for Jordan
50 min: introductory activity: pairs try the first two minutes of the conversation with Jordan, then list what they'd need to learn to do it well
10 min: preview the week: the feedback chapter, the SBI model, and the script due Sunday

modules.title: Fix the Handoff
modules.decision: Lunch, joint meeting, or a structural fix
modules.live: Applying the concept to their own job
segments: 10 min: check understanding: a poll on whether the 4:45 p.m. handoff is a people problem or a structure problem
15 min: guided practice: map the handoff together with the week's team framework
15 min: debate the split: lunch, joint meeting, or a structural fix
35 min: groups design a handoff fix for a team they know
15 min: debrief
review: 'Team Diagnosis Roundtable' repeated the memo prompt. Resolution: students design a fix for a team they know.

segments: 15 min: recap last week: a poll on coach or warn, and what the instructor saw in the scripts
15 min: introduce the module: the 4:45 p.m. handoff nobody owns
50 min: introductory activity: groups make a first call (lunch, joint meeting, or a structural fix) and list what they'd need to know
10 min: preview the week: the team reading and the memo due Sunday

modules.title: Telling Greg He's Wrong
segments: 10 min: check understanding: the week's Poll Everywhere results, plus one question on the root causes of disagreement
15 min: guided practice: the instructor and a volunteer play the opening exchange, and the class coaches Dana's next line
40 min: role-play in threes, Dana, Greg, observer
20 min: two volunteers replay for the class; instructor feedback
5 min: preview
15 min: recap last week: a poll on the handoff fix, and what the instructor saw in the memos
15 min: introduce the module: Greg wants a plan by Friday, and Dana thinks he's wrong
50 min: introductory activity: groups draft Dana's opening line, then try it once in pairs with the instructor coaching
10 min: preview the week: the conflict reading, the week's poll, and the memo to Greg due Sunday

modules.title: Twelve Things on the List
modules.live: A preview of the next assessment
segments: 10 min: check understanding: a poll on which of Dana's tasks only she can decide
15 min: guided practice: sort the first three items on Dana's list together
35 min: groups sort the rest of Dana's list, then their own
20 min: groups defend one decision-rights call
10 min: preview
setup: Shared sorting board link in the chat

segments: 15 min: recap last week: a poll on how Dana answered Greg, and what the instructor saw in the memos
15 min: introduce the module: twelve things on Dana's peak-season list
50 min: introductory activity: groups make a first sort of what Dana keeps and what she hands off
10 min: preview the week: the delegation reading and the decision-rights assignment due Sunday

modules.title: Table Read: Ending the Bonus
segments: 10 min: check understanding: a poll on what people hear first in a change message
15 min: guided practice: rewrite one line of a sample announcement together
40 min: students read drafts aloud in breakouts; peers play the crew
15 min: two drafts revised live with the class
10 min: preview
15 min: recap last week: a poll on Dana's delegation calls, and what the instructor saw in the assignments
15 min: introduce the module: the bonus is ending, and the floor is calling it a pay cut
50 min: introductory activity: groups list what the crew will hear first and draft one opening line
10 min: preview the week: the change reading and the announcement due Sunday

modules.title: Mock Interview Panel
